mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has increased by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rise in housing starts above the 12-month moving average signals robust consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average during a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past 3 months signals a weakening supply chain and reduced corporate output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% signals a weakening economy, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where quarterly GDP growth is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 6.0%), a further increase in the inflation rate signals an extended period of monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below the 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS falls below its 12-month moving average.
